children: U.S. homebuyers frustrated by high prices may finally have a seasonal advantage, with Redfin saying October is historically the best time to score a deal across 16 major metropolitan areas.
The opportunity is especially concentrated in the Midwest and East Coast, where homes listed during the spring and summer can become harder for sellers to move once the peak buying season fades.

Early October is typically the best bargain period in Boston, Chicago, Minneapolis, New Brunswick, N.J., and Orlando, according to an analysis from Redfin and Home Economics. Buyers in Cincinnati, Columbus, Indianapolis, Montgomery County, Philadelphia, Pittsburgh, Providence and Virginia Beach may find their strongest negotiating window around mid-October. Cleveland, Phoenix and Warren, Mich., tend to reach their sweet spot later in the month.
Seasonality trends suggest buyers in these places looking to score a bargain may want to get serious about their home search now that fall is here, Redfin senior economist Asad Khan said.

The seasonal advantage largely comes from sellers becoming more willing to negotiate after Labor Day. Redfin defines the best-deal period as the point when discounts from a home's original asking price, through either price cuts or negotiations, are close to their seasonal highs.
That does not necessarily mean October offers the widest selection.

Redfin cautioned that buyers have to balance price against choice. More inventory gives shoppers additional options, but greater competition can force stronger offers and reduce negotiating leverage. For financially prepared buyers willing to compromise somewhat on selection, October can offer some of the strongest bargaining opportunities of the year.

title: Redfin Says Homebuyers Just Got Rare October Window
